```{r}
#if padj < 0.05 and Log2foldchange positive

res_vs_non <- df2 %>%
    mutate(resnon = case_when(log2FoldChange > 0 & padj <= 0.05 ~ "Responder",
                              log2FoldChange <= 0 & padj >= 0.05 ~ "Non responder",
                              TRUE ~ "ns"))          
count(res_vs_non)             

```


```{r}

cols <- c("Responder" = "#ffad73", "Non responder" = "#26b3ff", "ns" = "grey") 
sizes <- c("Responder" = 2, "Non responder" = 2, "ns" = 1) 
alphas <- c("Responder" = 1, "Non responder" = 1, "ns" = 0.5)


res_vs_non %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = log2(log2FoldChange),
             y = -log10(padj),
             fill = resnon,    
             size = resnon,
             alpha = resnon)) + 
  geom_point(shape = 21,     
             colour = "black") + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.3, 0.3), linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols) + 
  scale_size_manual(values = sizes) + 
  scale_alpha_manual(values = alphas) + xlim(-2.5, 2.5) 
  


>>>>>>> Stashed changes

```

```{r}

resnon <- df2 %>%
  mutate(gene_type = case_when(log2FoldChange > 0 & padj <= 0.05 ~ "responder",
                               log2FoldChange < 0 & padj <= 0.05 ~ "non responder",
                               TRUE ~ "ns"))  




cols <- c("responder" = "#ffad73", "non responder" = "#26b3ff", "ns" = "grey") 
sizes <- c("responder" = 2, "non responder" = 2, "ns" = 1) 
alphas <- c("responder" = 1, "non responder" = 1, "ns" = 0.5)

resnon %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = log2FoldChange,
             y = -log(padj),
             fill = gene_type,    
             size = gene_type,
             alpha = gene_type)) + 
  geom_point(shape = 21, # Specify shape and colour as fixed local parameters    
             colour = "black") + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05),
             linetype = "dashed") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(log2(0.5), log2(2)),
             linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols) + # Modify point colour
  scale_size_manual(values = sizes) + # Modify point size
  scale_alpha_manual(values = alphas) + # Modify point transparency
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(seq(-10, 10, 2)),       
                     limits = c(-10, 10))  

```
```{r}
resnon %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = log2FoldChange,
             y = -log(padj))) + 
  geom_point(aes(color=level), shape = 21) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05),
             linetype = "dashed") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(log2(0.5), log2(2)),
             linetype = "dashed") + 
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2")
 

```



Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
